general: You are staring at this screen like it is going to magically pay your rent and do your laundry.
Your daily screen time is currently higher than your credit score. Let that sink in.
Your boss is literally promoting someone right now who doesn't have the attention span of a goldfish.
Put the phone down before your posture permanently evolves into a cooked macaroni noodle.
Every minute you spend staring at this screen, a boomer complains about your generation. Don't prove them right.
YouTube: Watching a 45-minute video essay on a movie you haven't even seen is not a personality trait.
You have watched enough DIY tutorials to build a house, yet you still can't fold a fitted sheet.
Binge-watching content won't magically solve the terrifying pile of responsibilities waiting for you in the real world.
Chrome: Opening 60 tabs won't make you look busy if 59 of them are abandoned online shopping carts.
Endlessly Googling 'how to be productive' instead of actually working is a whole new level of irony.
Your browser history is just a tragic timeline of you avoiding your actual adult responsibilities.
WhatsApp: You are treating group chats like a high-paying career, but your bank account says otherwise.
Typing 'lol' with a completely dead, expressionless face won't fix your social life.
Staring at the 'typing...' bubble isn't going to make them reply any faster. Go do your job.
Instagram: Doomscrolling through aesthetic morning routines while you rot in bed at 2 PM is wild.
Liking photos of other people's vacations isn't going to fund your own.
Watching food reels for an hour won't magically cook the groceries that are currently expiring in your fridge.
